working_definition: Author cell type 'T neuron T4/T5' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 376 nuclei): unsplit T4/T5 motion-detecting optic lobe neurons; authors' terms T4 neuron (FBbt:00003731) and T5 neuron (FBbt:00003736).
searches_performed: ancestors of T4a/T5b via EBI OLS4

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe that has its cell body in the posterior part of the optic lobe and a cell body fiber that bifurcates in the second optic chiasma (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: Grouped call T4/T5: the most specific common parent of T4 neuron and T5 neuron is T neuron (verified in ancestors). FBbt has no adult-specific T neuron variant (immature variants only).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its cell body posterior to the lobula plate that projects to medulla layer 10 and forms bleb-type arborizations in a single lobula plate layer.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only one member of the group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its cell body in the lobula plate cell body rind that projects to lobula layer 1 and forms bleb-type arborizations in a single lobula plate layer.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only one member of the group.

recommendation: Broad match to T neuron; members T4 and T5 listed.
